scripts.build:ios: node scripts/lim.mjs xcode build apps/ios --scheme HelloApp --inactivity-timeout 1m --upload e2e-limrun-ios.tar.gz --upload-ttl 24h && node scripts/lim.mjs assets pull e2e-limrun-ios.tar.gz --output build && tar -xzf build/e2e-limrun-ios.tar.gz -C build
scripts.build:android: node scripts/lim.mjs gradle build apps/android --inactivity-timeout 1m --upload e2e-limrun-android.apk --upload-ttl 24h && node scripts/lim.mjs assets pull e2e-limrun-android.apk --output build
scripts.build: npm run build:ios && npm run build:android
